As a result, this position must be recorded at fair value through profit or loss rather than held at amortized cost. I have an accounting memo prepared that is awaiting circulation, but I wanted to make sure the committee is aware of this classification requirement before the vote.

I confirmed in the exposure report I reviewed this morning that the bank already has $4 million of exposure to this issuer, and the applicable single-issuer limit is $10 million. That existing position has not yet been added to the committee packet. This proposed $12 million face value purchase would bring our total exposure to $16 million, well above the $10 million single-issuer limit. We cannot proceed without either a limit waiver or an approved exception from the appropriate authority.
